requirements.label: Every part requires sign-in; one account type
Roles come from the relationship; no requesting your own room
Owner creates and edits a room with metadata and timezone
Archive stops new requests, auto-declines Pending, keeps Confirmed
Signed-in users browse non-archived rooms and open any calendar
Weekly open windows on 30-minute boundaries, non-overlapping
Whole-day blackouts; open time is windows minus blackouts
Availability edits flag Confirmed and auto-decline Pending future items
Ranges are room-local, on the grid, half-open, future, may span days
Request accepted only inside open time and free of Confirmed overlap
Pending requests on one room may overlap
Owner approves or declines Pending requests on their room
Approval re-checks R10 and a future start, else stays Pending
Approval auto-declines overlapping Pending requests
Renter withdraws their own Pending request
Either party cancels a Confirmed booking before start; repeat cancel is a no-op
Started bookings are frozen; past-start Pending shows as expired
No two Confirmed bookings on a room ever overlap
Renters and owners see current status and decline cause
Owner's calendar shows everything, with renter identity and flags
Other users see anonymous booked blocks plus their own items
Room timezone is locked while future Pending or Confirmed items exist
Owner unarchives a room; no Declined request revives
No two identical Pending requests by one renter on one room
Limits: 31-day view, 180 days ahead, 7-day request, in room-local days
Declined, Withdrawn, and Cancelled are terminal
Nonexistent local times rejected; repeated ones take the earlier
Rejections report the first failing condition in a fixed order
Back-to-back request after a Confirmed booking is accepted
Request crossing closing time is rejected as outside availability
Approving one of two overlapping requests declines the other
Blackout flags a Confirmed booking and declines a Pending request
Owner cannot request their own room
Approving after the start is refused and shows expired
Request spanning midnight across open windows is accepted
Other renters see an anonymous block and no Pending requests
Two near-simultaneous approvals yield exactly one Confirmed
Timezone change with a future Confirmed booking is refused
Removing a blackout does not revive a declined request
Racing approve and withdraw: exactly one succeeds
Spring-forward 02:00 start is rejected as nonexistent
